DEEKSHA M N +91 8050229809 ⋄ Bengaluru,India

mndeeksha9@gmail.com ⋄ Linkedin

OBJECTIVE

Results-driven Middle office and Fund accounting professional with 7+ years of experience across global financial institutions. Skilled in Private Wealth Management, Balance sheet substantiation, Reconciliations, Ex- ternal vendor realtionship and payments, and Investment Operations, with a strong focus on Operational Risk, Internal Controls, and Audit Support. Proven ability to manage complex financial transactions, resolve exceptions, drive Process Improvements, and collaborate with global stakeholders to deliver high-quality service and operational excellence.

SKILLS

Middle Office & Wealth Management Operations: Private Wealth Management, Client Account Man- agement, Account Lifecycle Management, Capital & Income Account Oversight, Client Servicing, Operational Support

Process Improvement & Automation: Process Automation, Workflow Optimization, Continuous Improve- ment, Business Process Enhancement, Operational Efficiency, Dashboard Development

Project & Change Management: Process Migration, Change Management, Business Implementation, UAT Testing, Process Transition, Operational Readiness

Vendor Management & Governance: Vendor Onboarding, Vendor Governance, Outsourcing Management, Third-Party Coordination, Service Delivery Management

Reporting & Analytics: Management Reporting, MIS Reporting, KRI Tracking, Data Analysis, Dashboard Reporting, Business Intelligence Collaboration

Risk & Controls: Operational Risk Management, Balance Sheet Substantiation, Internal Controls, Compliance Support, Issue Resolution

Leadership & Stakeholder Management: Team Leadership, People Management, Stakeholder Engagement, Cross-functional Collaboration, Training & Mentoring, Client Relationship Management

WORK EXPERIENCE

Senior Associate (Team Leader) Goldman Sachs, Bengaluru, India

Nov 2021 – Present

Lead Middle Office operations for Private Wealth Management, overseeing account lifecycle activities and driving operational excellence to deliver a seamless client experience.

Partner with Business Intelligence teams to automate and streamline key operational processes, delivering annual capacity savings equivalent to 2 FTEs while enhancing process efficiency and control effectiveness.

Designed and executed targeted remediation strategies that reduced terminated accounts with residual balances by 80%, from $8M to $1.6M, strengthening risk management and operational governance.

Collaborate with regional leadership and business stakeholders to drive dormant account closure initiatives, optimizing system capacity, reducing maintenance costs, and mitigating operational and fraud-related risks.

Spearheaded the enterprise-wide migration from SRS to Keystone, ensuring successful implementation, standard- ized reporting, and improved operational consistency across multiple business divisions.

Manage vendor onboarding, governance, and outsourcing initiatives, strengthening third-party partnerships and improving service delivery and turnaround times.

Led the migration of global Middle Office processes by coordinating with cross-functional teams, delivering a seamless transition with 100% process accuracy and no business disruption.

Develop and enhance operational dashboards and management reporting solutions in collaboration with Business Intelligence and Operations teams, enabling data-driven decision-making and increased stakeholder transparency.

• Provide UAT support for new account setup and strategic process enhancements, ensuring successful implemen-

tation of technology and operational change initiatives.

Business Implementation Analyst Societe Generale, Bangalore, India

May 2021 – Nov 2021

• Supported implementation of business and technology solutions by gathering requirements, analyzing workflows,

and coordinating with cross-functional stakeholders.

Facilitated User Acceptance Testing (UAT), issue resolution, and deployment activities to support successful project delivery and business transitions.

Partnered with operational teams to identify opportunities for Process Improvement, workflow optimization, and automation initiatives that enhanced service delivery.

Prepared and maintained SOPs, process documentation, business requirement documents, and operational reports to ensure compliance with governance standards.

Assisted in risk assessments, issue tracking, and control reviews to support operational stability and regulatory compliance.

Collaborated with business, technology, and operations teams to manage change initiatives, resolve implementa- tion challenges, and support continuous improvement programs.

Analyst Northern Trust, Bengaluru, India

Mar 2020 – May 2021

Supported Fund Accounting and Fund Administration activities, including NAV Validation, financial reporting, and client servicing for institutional investment funds.

Performed Cash Reconciliations, Position Reconciliations, and Market Value Reconciliations, inves- tigating and resolving exceptions to ensure accuracy of portfolio and accounting records.

Assisted in the preparation and review of Financial Reporting packages, supporting timely month-end and periodic reporting requirements.

Collaborated with global stakeholders to resolve operational queries, manage escalations, and ensure adherence to service delivery standards and SLAs.

EDUCATION

Master of Business Administration , Bangaluru University Bachelor of Commerce, Kuvempu University Coursework: Financial Management, Investment Analysis, Portfolio Management, Risk Management, Corporate Finance, Financial Markets,Financial Accounting, Cost Accounting, Auditing, Taxation, Business Statistics, Banking & Finance

CERTIFICATIONS

SAP FI Tally ERP Advanced Excel Indian Financial Markets Banking & Insurance

SAP Tally Solutions Pvt. Ltd. Microsoft Financial Markets Certification Finance & Banking Program
